note: Set A captures more of the sheet's substantive specifications correctly — the A36 threaded rod, (1) 2-1/4" heavy hex nut, keeper plate, pin connection plate, 11" dia x 1/2" plate, A325 bolt, W8X10 beam and neoprene pad — while Set B invents or misreads several values (PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 given thickness 1/2" and separately "length 1 inch" when 1 is the thickness, and the 12" elevation-difference accommodation restated as rod "length capacity"). Set B also misbinds L3X3X1/4 to the diagonal brace and HSS4X4X1/4 to a "bracing member," and adds unverifiable orientation attributes (vertical/horizontal) to bare dimensions. Set A's weaknesses are duplicated claims and several unbound "component | dimension" entries (1/4", 4 3/4", 1'-5 1/4", 3 1/2"), plus a fabricated join making the column cap plate L3X3X1/4 and a misread of "3X 1/4" as quantity 3. Set B does add useful facts A misses (28" dia plate, C3X6, 12" elevation difference, 2 5/16" teflon hole), but its misread values are more damaging.
